notes.title: Kerker Patch Notes - September 6, 2024
notes.notes:
Changes


Added game version on main menu
Added two challenge dungeons (challenge dungeons don't yield loot)
Tweaked shadow rendering settings to boost performance
Dungeon summary screen now displays dungeon name

notes.title: Kerker Patch Notes - September 5, 2024
notes.notes:
Changes


Added initial bomb kicking hint indicator
Leveling up now adds 4 maximum HP
Moved pillars in crossbow boss room closer together
Added occlusion culling to enhance performance


Bugfixes


Fixed being able to hide/show systems menu in in-game options menu
Minimize chances of enemies getting stuck on corners during pathfinding
